latestVersion.changelog:
AI video editor for Arabic content creators, with automatic Arabic subtitles and easy cloud processing.

- Upload Arabic-language video files (up to 500MB) and request edits, captions, or trims in natural language.
- Automatically authenticates and connects to the processing backend; guides users through setup if needed.
- Supports MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, and other major video/audio/image formats.
- Generates 1080p MP4 outputs with fast cloud GPU rendering (typically 1-2 minutes per edit).
- Exposes simple commands for export, balance, status, and batch or iterative editing.
- Handles errors like missing credits, large files, or expired tokens with clear user guidance.
